description.name: Enhance Special: Jade Shatter Strike Phase 2
description.desc:
When Energy is sufficient and in the <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky-Piercing Stance]</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launch a powerful series of lunging thrusts forward, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
This skill is considered a <color=#FFFFFF>[Draw Stance]</color>;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Defensive Assist: Unyielding Frost
description.desc:

name: Core Passive: Sky Knight
Additional Ability: Sky Alliance
desc:
<color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack]</color> 4th hit, <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Chain Attack]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Ultimate]</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>[Dodge Counter]</color> are considered <color=#FFFFFF>[Draw Stance]</color>;
When Sigrid hits an enemy with any <color=#FFFFFF>[Draw Stance]</color>, if not currently in <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color>, she enters <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> and the <color=#FFFFFF>[Draw Stance]</color> that landed the hit enters <color=#FFFFFF>[Inactive]</color> status, while gaining 1 <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> activation opportunity, up to a maximum of 1;
While in <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color>, when Sigrid uses any <color=#FFFFFF>[Draw Stance]</color> that is not in <color=#FFFFFF>[Inactive]</color> status, she can refresh <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> and gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> activation opportunity, up to a maximum of 1; When <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> is refreshed, the <color=#FFFFFF>[Inactive]</color> status transfers to the newly triggered <color=#FFFFFF>[Draw Stance]</color>;
When <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> hits an enemy, <color=#FFFFFF>[Inactive]</color> status is removed and the next <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> advances by 1 stage, up to a maximum of 3 stages; After triggering the 3rd stage <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> stage is immediately reset to stage 1 and <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> ends;
The duration of <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> decreases as <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> stage increases: at stages 1/2/3, the duration is <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>7</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>6</color>s respectively;
When <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> ends, <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> stage decreases by 1, down to a minimum of stage 1;
When <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> is activated or refreshed, Sigrid's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>36%</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s; repeated triggers can extend the duration by <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s, up to a maximum duration of <color=#FFFFFF>40</color>s;
While in <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color>, the Energy Cost of <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color> is reduced.

1.name: A long, long time ago,
1.desc: After triggering the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>[Weapon Retraction Stance]</color>, enters <color=#FFFFFF>[Aerial Patrol Gunstance]</color>; grants a <color=#FFFFFF>25%</color> ATK bonus.
1.desc2:
Long, long ago, the great Sunbringer scooped up the very first handful of earth on the sky islands…
Hold on, hold on — the kids have heard the story of Lady Sunbringer building the first island of Roscaelifer so many times their ears have grown calluses.
What we're here to talk about today is the story of the warrior who stood at Lady Sunbringer's side — clad in silver-white armor as radiant as a moonlit night, just like a Knight of old from a fairy tale…

2.name: Act One of the Legendary
2.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>[Draw Shot]</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Shot]</color> deal <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> that ignores <color=#FFFFFF>24%</color> of the target's DEF; the duration of the <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Stance]</color> effect is extended;
2.desc2:
She was Roscaelifer's first Soldier, its first spear — standing at the first line of defense against the Hollow, leading the first charge.
She was the first wing to follow Lady Sunbringer, and with her own hands raised the first walls of Roscaelifer.
She was the first blade of Roscaelifer to be broken. Her name was de L'Azur.
Her children, like her legend, burn eternal in the night sky over Roscaelifer.

4.name: Hero Upgrading
4.desc: Each time <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunstance]</color> refreshes, your DMG dealt increases by <color=#FFFFFF>30%</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s. Repeated triggers can extend the duration by <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s, up to a maximum of <color=#FFFFFF>40</color>s.

6.name: Knight of the Skies
6.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> 1st/2nd/3rd hit on an enemy deals an additional <color=#FFFFFF>400%</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>500%</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>600%</color> DMG.
